credits.title: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 - AK47
credits.overview: A tight-knit family faces an unexpected crisis that threatens their bond, forcing them to re-evaluate their values and fight to stay united.

credits.title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
credits.overview: As rival gangs, corrupt officials and a ruthless Major Iqbal close in, Hamza's mission for his country spirals into a bloody personal war where the line between patriot and monster disappears in the streets of Lyari.

credits.title: Ikk Kudi
credits.overview: In a family where love stories always end in heartbreak, Simis arranged marriage is seen as a longoverdue new beginning. Her fiancé is charming, successful, and everything her parents hoped for. But just days before the wedding, a whisper of doubt creeps into Simi’s mind — and it refuses to leave.

credits.title: Amar Singh Chamkila
credits.overview: A humble singer's brash lyrics ignite fame and fury across Punjab as he grapples with soaring success and brutal criticism before his untimely death.

credits.title: Gold
credits.overview: Set in 1948, the historic story of India's first Olympic medal post their independence.
